positions.title: Programmer Intern
positions.description:
- Quickly grasped programming in C#, as well as concepts such as MVC patterns and data binding and successfully applied them to the summer project
- Collaborated with product and engineering team members to design user interface for the beta-version of a new Financial Aid Web application
- Architected 92% of the Web application pages layouts and tailored them to satisfy user requirements by implementing specified business rules
- Enhanced user experience by making the user interface interactive and responsive to various Ajax requests using knockout.js to create 90% of data bindings and custom mappings
- Connected the Web layer of the application with the API by building Model-View-Controller Components for a variety of data objects in .Net utilizing an array of data structures: Lists, Dictionaries, KeyValue Pairs, etc.
- Undertook part of the back end work by learning and applying the knowledge to construct an endpoint in the API through developing DTOs (Data Transfer Objects used to transfer data between software subsystems), Domain Entities (objects), specifying a path, etc.
- Investigated the cons and pros of implementing a displayable/printable version of a document using PDF and HTML by conducting research about those technologies with another employee. Implemented both versions utilizing independently discovered tools: jspdf.js and html2canvas.js

positions.description:

Monitored the online application, troubleshot and reported problems to the      IT manager

projects.title: Spotify Streamer App
projects.description: Implemented an Android app that uses Spotify API to render artists, tracks, and preview urls on user’s search and Picasso API to load thumbnails into the app’s views. Extended Service and MediaPlayer classes to create a custom media player for retrieved tracks playback. Optimized the UI by utilizing Master-Detail structure for tablet view.

projects.title: Personal App Portfolio
projects.description: Designed and built an app that shows off the projects created as part of the Android Developer Nanodegree program.
